threads.body: The guard only checks the non-beta `openai.resources.chat.completions.Completions.parse` API, so SDK versions where structured outputs are exposed as `client.beta.chat.completions.parse` (including the 1.40.x introduction path) will skip wrapping entirely and still emit no telemetry for `parse()`. Please also detect and wrap the beta `Completions.parse`/`AsyncCompletions.parse` classes when present, or otherwise narrow the supported version claim/tests to the non-beta API.

replies.body:
For version `skew. parse()`, was on the beta path in openai 1.40 through 1.91, then moved to the main path in 1.92 when  the beta module went away, so the current main-only guard genuinely no-ops for users on that older range.
 
I'd like to keep this PR narrowed to the non-beta API for now, which is the second option you offered. It also matches what landed in contrib (PR (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-contrib/pull/4416), commit 23e1a47d), and the pytestmark.skipif on both test files gates tests on the same predicate as the wrap, so CI can't claim coverage we don't have.
 
Will file a follow-up issue to add the beta-path wrap and a tox env pinned to a 1.40-1.91 release so it actually gets exercised. If maintainers would rather fold that into this PR, I'm good to do it here instead, please confirm @lzchen @lmolkova ?
